integrity.finite_computations: 1907 finite assertions from the packaged Python standard-library checker; not a substitute for proof
integrity.proof_basis: explicit radial-moment Fourier decomposition, gamma midpoint convexity, trigamma bounds, dominated convergence and Fatou

scientific_limitations: One complex variable; the exact radial power-exponential weight family.
Finite leakage coefficient is proved for arbitrary L2 angular symbols, but Toeplitz operator representation is used only for bounded unimodular symbols.
No uniform error rate over all H1 symbols or extension to arbitrary radial weights is claimed.
Historical priority relative to equivalent broader trace theorems is not exhaustively established.
title: The sharp angular Sobolev leakage law for harmonic power-Fock projections
